location.zh: 怀特星 炫彩山 山神圣殿

capture.zh: 在炫彩山神秘洞窟收集齐4块灵魂残片，到最高层山神圣殿使用、点击山神解开封印后挑战；打败山神获得迪符特精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消强化，然后用魔焰猩猩/阿克希亚等秒杀技秒杀；或布林克克/布鲁克克海洋之心削血后黑电、斯普林特自杀，再上雷伊或谱尼收尾；该隐暗影护盾骗物攻MISS也可。

engine_notes: infinite_pp: the boss's skills never run out of PP (players could not win by 耗PP).
immune_status: 4399 says 烧伤、冻伤技能无效、免疫疲惫等异常状态; 海洋之心 (pct damage) explicitly works.
Battle displayed the level as '??' (等级问号级); level 80 is an estimate matching contemporary SPT bosses.
Unlock is an exploration step (collect 4 灵魂残片 in 炫彩山神秘洞窟), not a prior boss fight.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 SPT page (2011-08) gives HP 10000, PP无限 and status immunity; release 2011-06-10 per 4399 obtain guide.
